_comment: T54 moderation spike fixtures — campus-Q&A-shaped text, not generic toxicity samples.
`expect` is the disposition Murmur wants (TRD A7 tiers): pass | block | escalate.
The `must_pass` set is the important one: Murmur's whole value is frank senior advice
about placements and professors. A provider that blocks honest criticism is useless here,
so false POSITIVES on must_pass are disqualifying in a way false negatives are not.
The `hinglish` group matters because NIT Jalandhar posts will be code-mixed;
most English-trained classifiers degrade badly on it. Test it before committing.

samples.text: How hard is it to get into the Microsoft campus drive from ECE? What CGPA cutoff did they use last year?
Which electives in 6th sem CSE are actually useful for placements and which are just easy scoring?
Is the hostel mess food edible in first year or should I budget for eating outside most days?
Honestly the Data Structures professor is a terrible teacher. He reads slides word for word and gets annoyed at questions. Self-study from Abdul Bari and you will do fine.
The placement cell is disorganised and over-promises. They said 90% placement but that counts a lot of low-paying mass recruiters. Do not rely on them alone.
I failed two backlogs and I am really stressed about whether I will even graduate on time. How do people recover from this?
Bhai placement ke liye DSA kitna karna padta hai? 3rd year se start karu toh late toh nahi ho jayega?
Yaar us professor ka attendance policy bakwaas hai, 85% mandatory karta hai aur khud classes cancel karta rehta hai.
Rohit Sharma from 3rd year CSE is a worthless loser, everyone should avoid him, he is pathetic and deserves to fail.
That girl in the second row of the ML lecture has a great body, someone get me her number and hostel room.
Here is the warden's home address and personal mobile: 42 Model Town, Jalandhar, 98xxxxxx01. Everyone call him tonight and make him regret it.
If that examiner fails me again I will wait outside his house and break his legs.
Us bande ko dekh ke gussa aata hai, saale ko hostel ke bahar pakad ke maarunga.
I have failed the same paper three times and I genuinely do not want to be alive anymore. There is no point continuing.
Seniors in B hostel made the first years stand in the corridor till 3am again and made them do push-ups until they cried.
A professor in the mechanical department is asking female students to come to his cabin alone in the evening and making them uncomfortable.
EARN 5000/day WORK FROM HOME!! Limited seats!! WhatsApp +91 90000 00000 now for placement guarantee course!!!
